text: On the grey-blue final Sunday of the Pallister Cup, the yacht Seren Aduial crossed the Northfold line with Niamh Corrigan at the helm, sealing a result that many here had long expected but few had dared call early. The victory ends a three-year climb for the West Quay syndicate, whose first attempt in the cup in 2021 was cut short by storm damage off Bracken Point. Corrigan, a former harbor pilot from Lathmere, took over captaincy last winter after a reshuffle that also brought in navigator Ivo Senn. In the close-run 14-mile course, Seren Aduial finished 38 seconds ahead of Orselyn, with five thousand spectators lining the pier and old rivalries briefly softened by the afternoon calm.
